blocking_focus: locomotion_blockout_objective_trace: the Alpha Area3D has collision and visible markers but no authoritative enter/leave state owner, signal binding, event history, or recorded transition.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Close the Alpha objective-trace gap by binding the existing placeholder volume to a minimal authoritative enter/leave state owner whose diagnostics agree with ordinary player movement, while preserving the verified locomotion controller, bounded blockout room, restart behavior, and clean boot without importing later-phase map, combat, HUD, or production assets.

diagnosis.root_cause: The reachable Alpha Area3D is only collision and presentation geometry. It has no candidate-owned objective controller, body_entered/body_exited bindings, authoritative overlap state, deduplicated transition handling, or bounded event history, while PrototypePlayer diagnostics expose locomotion only. Ordinary movement therefore cannot produce the authoritative objective trace required by the locomotion blockout phase.

stop_conditions: Do not expand this repair into capture timing, enemies, checkpoints, production HUD, weapons, or authored-map intake.
Do not replace or materially retune the verified player hierarchy, locomotion parameters, room layout, route cover, Alpha geometry, or orientation cues.
Do not hand off if clean boot regresses, runtime errors appear, or Alpha transitions can be generated without ordinary player overlap.
Stop after the required Alpha trace passes and preserve the blocked backlog review for a later host-selected iteration.

strategy.rationale: Repair the missing ownership boundary directly: retain the existing Area3D and player implementation, attach one small placeholder-objective controller, bind its overlap signals, and expose bounded authoritative telemetry. This is the narrowest change that makes physical enter/leave evidence causal and testable.

code: Verify the Alpha controller owns state and that main.tscn binds it to AlphaPlaceholder with an explicit PrototypePlayer filter and runtime-discovery group.
Verify enter/leave handlers deduplicate occupants, emit transitions only on authoritative state changes, and cap retained history.
Run the candidate's focused parse/boot validation and confirm no missing resources, invalid callbacks, or signal errors.
Re-run the frozen clean_boot check and require pass.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester starts from fresh F6 state, confirms Alpha is outside with zero transitions, and records player position plus objective telemetry.
Using ordinary movement only, traverse the collision-backed route into Alpha and require player position, Area overlap, inside state, enter event, and transition count to agree.
Move fully outside again and require overlap false, outside state, a matching leave event, ordered event history, and no duplicate transition.
Repeat a fresh F6 launch and confirm the initial Alpha state and captured-input locomotion behavior reset deterministically.
visual: Capture distinct outside/approach, inside, and after-exit first-person frames paired with their runtime states; the player must physically cross the existing volume.
Confirm the cyan Alpha pad, posts, and label remain readable and do not cross the near plane, cover the reticle, or become a full-height visual curtain.
Confirm the bounded room, route cover, clearance fixture, cyan/amber orientation cues, neutral exposure, and human-scale camera framing remain visually unchanged.

done_when: AlphaPlaceholder owns a stable Alpha identity, authoritative outside/inside state, current player-overlap predicate, transition count, last event, and bounded event history.
body_entered and body_exited are bound to the objective owner and accept only the PrototypePlayer through an explicit player identity or group.
A physical outside→inside→outside traversal records exactly one enter and one leave transition with stable event IDs, monotonic sequence or timestamp data, and matching before/after states.
Duplicate callbacks or unrelated bodies cannot double-submit a transition, and the diagnostic history remains bounded.
Alpha objective telemetry is discoverable in bounded runtime state alongside the existing player position and locomotion telemetry.
Fresh scene restart returns Alpha to its initial outside state without changing the existing locomotion, camera, collision, or input-reset behavior.
No production capture timer, checkpoint, HUD, map, weapon, enemy, or decorative system is introduced.
The project boots cleanly with no script parse, missing-resource, or signal-binding errors.
tasks.instructions: Implement a minimal candidate-owned controller for the existing Room/AlphaPlaceholder Area3D and bind its body_entered/body_exited signals. Give PrototypePlayer an explicit identity the controller can filter, deduplicate occupants, and make the controller—not geometry, labels, or diagnostics—the authority for Alpha outside/inside transitions. Record a small bounded immutable-style event trace containing stable event ID, monotonic sequence or timestamp, transition kind, prior state, resulting state, and player identity. Expose objective ID, overlap state, occupant count, transition count, last event, and bounded history through runtime-discoverable diagnostics. Preserve the current room, Alpha marker presentation, player hierarchy and movement behavior; do not add later-phase capture or production systems.
tasks.title: Bind authoritative Alpha enter/leave trace
